title: 5 Critical Considerations for Hospitals Evaluating Weapons Screening Technology
summary: This buyer’s guide breaks down five key areas to consider when evaluating a weapons detection system for your hospital entrance.
body_markdown:
***How to Strengthen Security, Support Patient Care, and Meet Operational Requirements When Selecting a Weapons Detection Solution***


Choosing the right weapons screening technology for a hospital requires looking beyond detection alone. Healthcare leaders must consider how screening fits into patient flow, clinical workflows, security operations, IT infrastructure, and the overall care experience.


This buyer’s guide breaks down five key areas to consider when evaluating a screening solution, along with practical questions to help inform your vendor evaluation and security strategy.


#### Inside, you’ll learn how to evaluate:


- Patient flow and alignment with access-to-care requirements
- Patient dignity and the overall screening experience
- Operational flexibility and readiness for changing conditions
- Reporting, analytics, IT integration, cybersecurity, and privacy
